content: The body is a musical instrument with seven strings; when tuned to divine love, it plays the melody of eternal life.
author: Kabir
explanation: The human body and its energy centers are designed to be instruments of divine expression. When thoughts, speech, and actions are harmonized by love, life becomes living music.
practicalInsight: Treat your body and mind with deep reverence today. Feed them clean nutrition, wholesome thoughts, and uplifting music.
reflectionPrompt: Is the instrument of my life playing the music of love, or the noise of agitation?
